Good to know

  • It doesn't run while charging.
  • In the box: massager, USB charging cable, user manual.

This is a massager for relaxation. It is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. If you are pregnant, have a pacemaker or a medical condition, ask your doctor before using it.

seo.description: Soft silicone patches you wear overnight to help smooth the look of forehead and expression lines. Washable and reusable. Free tracked shipping across the US.

gid://shopify/Product/12313877840136.descriptionHtml:
Wake up with a smoother-looking forehead. These soft silicone patches gently hold the skin still while you sleep, so you don't spend the night frowning, squinting or pressing your face into the pillow. In the morning, peel them off, rinse and use them again.

Why they're in our ritual

  • Helps smooth the look of expression lines on the forehead and around the eyes.
  • Reusable: wash with water and mild soap, let them air-dry and they're ready for the next night.
  • Nothing to absorb: no creams, no fragrance, just flexible silicone.
  • Comfortable: thin, soft and made to follow the shape of your face.

How to use

  1. Cleanse and fully dry your skin (no creams or oils where the patch goes).
  2. Smooth the skin gently with your fingers and press the patch on.
  3. Wear it overnight or for a few hours, then peel off and rinse.

Which set?

  • Forehead + 4 Eye Patches: 1 forehead patch and 4 under-eye patches.
  • Forehead + Smile Line Set: forehead patch plus patches for the smile-line and chin area.

Results vary from person to person. Do not use on broken, irritated or sunburned skin. Stop using if you notice redness or irritation.
